scripts.sync:studio: bun -e "const fs = require('fs'); const src = '../frontends/playground/out'; const dest = 'studio/out'; if (fs.existsSync(src)) { if (fs.existsSync(dest)) fs.rmSync(dest, { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.cpSync(src, dest, { recursive: true }); }"
scripts.build:electron: bun build src/main/index.ts --target=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/main/index.js --external=electron && bun build src/preload/index.ts --target=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/preload/index.js --external=electron
scripts.build: bun run sync:studio && bun run build:splash && bun run build:electron
